title: Gate results are read from the first and last line of a log text
what: A script reads the gate log by the text of its first and last line (lib/relay_marks.py:170-181, lib/relay_gate.py:69-71); store a JSON summary (head, exit, failed tests, duration) beside each log and read that.
why: A wording change in the gate output silently changes what the merge check believes about a branch.
failing_case: change the last line the gate prints (for example a different 'passed' wording): relay_marks reads the log as not passing though the gate exited 0, or as passing though it failed; a JSON summary beside the log would not depend on the wording
pass_cases: a log with the usual first and last lines is read correctly today
